acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: Geirid and Chrissy are extreme planners. But about a year ago, they were confronted with a situation that even they had no idea how to plan for.
acts.credits: By Laura Starecheski; Produced by Miki Meek

acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Geirid and Chrissy make an “in case of emergency, break glass” spreadsheet and get some big news.
acts.title: Freak in the Spreadsheets

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: Geirid and Chrissy have less than a month to make a life-changing decision. The government gives them two options, and they try to find a third.
acts.title: When the Bureaucratic Shark Bites

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
A short story from Rachel Khong: Two people have a very consequential choice to make, given to them by God.
This story was read for us by actor Melissa Tang. You can read the full version of this story, “D-Day,” in Rachel’s new book of short stories, My Dear You, and hear her read it in the audiobook version.
acts.credits: By Rachel Khong; Produced by Diane Wu
acts.title: Beast Friends Furr-ever
